label: For "Coding Agent Evaluation Harness": Evaluate coding agents on a company's own repositories and tasks with hidden tests, cost and safety checks so model and prompt changes are judged on evidence before rollout. Define the label exactly as in milestone M1: what counts as a positive or a correct outcome, and when it becomes known. Design around this trap first: Public benchmarks only.
